cases.name: Katelynn Armand-Tylka
cases.narrative: Katelynn dropped off their daughter where Tylka lived with his mother and step-father. He removed his daughter (who was still in her car seat) from the car and placed her in the home's entry way. He then walked back to the car and shot Katelynn eight times with the newly-purchased 9 mm handgun, six times in the chest and twice in head.
